_readme: The demo's one companion, and the whole recruiting mechanism: a CHOICE carrying set_flag,
with hidden_if_flag on the same choice so a second conversation cannot ask again. There is
no join op and no roster - the party is whoever's flag is set, computed fresh every time it
is asked, exactly as knowing a spell is computed fresh from level.
The gift idiom, applied to a person. Both replies END the talk, because a choice line cannot
be escaped with cancel and a conversation that looped back through one would have no way out.
She says what she is FOR before she is taken, for the reason the hermit names the oil: a
player who has not fought yet has no way to know what a second sword is worth.

greet.speaker: Rook
greet.text: Warden won't have me. Says one sword is enough for a village this size.

ask.speaker: Rook
ask.text: The road east disagrees. Two of us come back from it; one doesn't.

joined.speaker: Rook
joined.text: Right. I'll take the left side. Try to keep up.

alone.speaker: Rook
alone.text: You will, probably. I'll be here either way.

along.speaker: Rook
along.text: Still here. Still the left side.
